prompt: Write a single, self-contained prompt for a text-to-image model that has never heard of Chinese memes, so that it draws a giraffe version of the "大笑奶龙" (Laughing Nailong / 奶蛙) meme. Output only the prompt.
answer: A square, slightly low-resolution and over-compressed 3D cartoon render of a chubby baby giraffe laughing hysterically, styled like a cheap glossy plastic-toy CGI character from a low-budget children's cartoon. The giraffe is chibi and round: an oversized ball-shaped head, short thick neck, fat pear-shaped little body, stubby legs with tiny hooves, small leaf-shaped ears sticking out sideways, two short knob-tipped horn nubs on top of the head, soft cream-yellow fur covered in rounded orange-brown patchwork spots, a paler belly, and a short tail with a dark tuft. Its head is thrown far back so the neck arcs backward and the muzzle points up toward the ceiling; the mouth gapes absurdly wide open, a huge dark cavern swallowing more than half the face, with a long floppy dark purple tongue lolling out over the lower lip and two blunt white bottom teeth, nostrils flared and stretched. The eyes are squeezed completely shut into two thin upward-curving crescent lines, eyebrows shot up high, one tiny cartoon teardrop flicking from the corner of an eye, pink blush ovals on the cheeks. It rears back on its stubby hind legs with both tiny front hooves flung up in the air, body squashed and tilted, caught mid belly-laugh. A few simple black curved shake-lines and motion arcs float around the head. Plain flat white background, harsh even lighting, cheap plastic specular highlights, slightly off-model and faintly uncanny proportions, crude, garish and unhinged in mood, centered sticker-like crop, no text, no watermark, no border.
